## Assignment 1
In this assignment, you will implement your own neural networks to classify non-linear data from the XOR dataset. For deliverables, you must write code in Python/PyTorch and submit the below Jupyter Notebook file (.ipynb) to earn a total of 150 pts. Note that you must save your Notebook filename under this format: **yourUVAUserId_assignment_1_ann.ipynb**.
